exclusions.name: Other bakery staff or volunteers
exclusions.why_safe: Only Sara Copperwheat staffs the stand, Tomas Ilic runs the oven, and Jo Fenwick drives; no other actors are mentioned as involved in production or delivery before noon.

exclusions.name: Third-party delivery services
exclusions.why_safe: The evidence states no bakery vehicle other than the two scheduled runs is due before 3:00 PM, and no other delivery method is mentioned.

exclusions.name: Overnight storage at the stand
exclusions.why_safe: Festival rules prohibit overnight storage, so the stand starts empty.

exclusions.name: Loaves baked after 10:00 AM
exclusions.why_safe: The oven switches to regular trade at 10:00 AM, and the next delivery is at 3:00 PM, after the deadline.

uncertainties.meaning: Whether the oven runs continuously from 5:00 AM to 10:00 AM without interruption, and whether the production rate of 30 loaves per hour holds exactly.

Exactly how many loaves baked between 5:00 AM and 10:00 AM are fully cooled by 11:00 AM, given the 60-minute cooling requirement and the 11:00 AM departure.
Whether the van is loaded to its full capacity of 90 loaves or only with the cooled loaves available at 8:00 AM, and whether any loaves from Friday evening are included.
